1. AGREEMENT TO THESE TERMS

These Terms of Use (the “Terms”) are a legal agreement between you and MESH Studios LLC (“MESH,” “we,” “us,” or “our”) governing your access to and use of the MESH mobile application, websites, software, fantasy sports experiences, social and community features, virtual currency, digital items, promotions, and related products and services (collectively, the “Services”).

2. ABOUT MESH

MESH is primarily a free-to-play social fantasy sports and gaming platform built around squads, leagues, communities, collaborative roster management, digital identity, and social competition. The Services may allow users to form or join squads, participate in fantasy leagues, collaboratively manage rosters, communicate with other users, react to fantasy activity, and acquire or use digital cosmetic content.

MESH may also provide sponsored experiences, brand content, challenges, referrals, promotional opportunities, community initiatives, and philanthropy-related experiences. Unless separate official rules expressly provide otherwise, the standard MESH fantasy experience does not require users to pay an entry fee and does not award users cash or other real-world prizes based on fantasy performance.

3. ELIGIBILITY AND ACCOUNT REGISTRATION

You must be at least 18 years old to create an account or use the Services. By using the Services, you represent and warrant that you meet this requirement. MESH does not knowingly permit anyone under 18 to register, and may suspend or terminate any account it reasonably believes belongs to an ineligible user. You may use the Services only if you are legally permitted to do so and your use complies with applicable law.

When creating an account, you must provide accurate and current information. MESH may request information such as your email address, telephone number, date of birth, username, first name, last initial, school or community affiliation, or other information reasonably needed to provide the Services. You are responsible for your account credentials and all activity conducted through your account.

You may not impersonate another person, create an account using materially false information, sell or transfer your account without our permission, use another person’s account without authorization, or create accounts for abusive, fraudulent, or evasive purposes.

4. SQUADS, LEAGUES, COMMUNITIES, AND SHARED CONTROL

MESH may organize users into squads, leagues, chapters, schools, alumni groups, creator communities, fan groups, or other communities. Certain users, including squad leaders, commissioners, or administrators, may receive additional permissions to manage membership, settings, roster decisions, communications, or shared Digital Items.

By joining a squad or other shared group, you understand that actions taken by authorized leaders or administrators can affect your experience. For example, a squad leader may control whether another member can equip or change a squad Digital Item. Purchasing or contributing to a squad Digital Item does not guarantee that the purchaser will have administrative permission to equip or select that item.

MESH is not responsible for disagreements among members concerning squad leadership, roster decisions, membership, permissions, strategy, or use of shared Digital Items, except to the extent required by law.

5. FANTASY SPORTS, SCORING, AND SPORTS DATA

MESH may use sports statistics, schedules, injury information, projections, scoring feeds, and other data provided by MESH or third parties. Sports data may be delayed, corrected, incomplete, unavailable, or subject to official statistical changes. MESH may correct fantasy scores, standings, results, or other errors when appropriate.

Unless separate official rules state otherwise, MESH does not guarantee any projection, statistic, score, matchup result, or other sports information will be error-free, complete, or available at all times. MESH may resolve scoring or rules questions in a reasonable manner consistent with the applicable league or feature rules.

6. MESH COINS

MESH may offer a closed-loop virtual currency referred to in these Terms as “MESH Coins” or “Coins.” Coins may be purchased in fixed or other offered amounts through Apple In-App Purchase, Google Play Billing, or another payment method permitted by the applicable platform and law. MESH may also, now or in the future, award Coins without charge through challenges, referrals, achievements, brand campaigns, promotions, customer support adjustments, or other activities.

Coins are virtual items licensed for use only within the Services. Coins are not money, stored value, cryptocurrency, securities, deposits, or property with a guaranteed cash value. Coins do not accrue interest and may not be redeemed from MESH for cash or any other real-world monetary value except where required by law.

Coins may not currently be transferred, sold, traded, gifted, or exchanged between users unless MESH expressly enables such functionality in the future. MESH may impose reasonable limits on Coin purchases, balances, uses, or promotional awards to prevent fraud, abuse, or technical problems.

Coins purchased through Apple In-App Purchase will not expire. If MESH later offers promotional or no-cost Coins subject to expiration or different conditions, those conditions will be disclosed when the Coins are awarded, subject to applicable law and platform rules.

Coins currently cannot be used as an entry fee or other consideration to enter MESH fantasy competitions.

7. DIGITAL ITEMS AND ENTITLEMENTS

The Services may offer mascots, animations, taunts, reactions, badges, cosmetics, avatars, visual effects, or other virtual content (collectively, “Digital Items”). Digital Items may be acquired using Coins or through challenges, promotions, achievements, codes, brand activations, or other methods.

Digital Items are licensed, not sold, and do not give you ownership of MESH intellectual property or any real-world asset. Unless MESH expressly provides otherwise, Digital Items cannot be redeemed for cash, sold, traded, transferred outside the Services, or used as consideration in a financial transaction.

PERSONAL DIGITAL ITEMS

A Personal Digital Item is tied to the individual account that acquired it. Subject to these Terms and continued availability of the Services, a purchased Personal Digital Item is intended to remain available to that account and does not expire merely because it is no longer offered for new purchase.

SQUAD DIGITAL ITEMS

A Squad Digital Item is acquired for and licensed to a designated squad rather than to the individual purchaser. Once acquired for a squad, the entitlement remains with that squad even if the purchaser leaves. The purchaser does not retain a separate personal entitlement to that squad item solely because the purchaser supplied the Coins used to acquire it. If the squad is deleted, dissolved, or otherwise permanently removed from the Services, the associated Squad Digital Items may cease to be available and generally will not transfer to former members or another squad.

PERMISSIONS

A squad leader or other authorized administrator may control which members may equip, select, or change Squad Digital Items. Buying a Squad Digital Item does not override squad permissions or leadership controls.

UPDATES TO DIGITAL ITEMS

MESH may update the design, rendering, animation, technical format, name, presentation, or quality of a Digital Item over time. For example, MESH may replace an existing version with an improved three-dimensional or otherwise updated version while preserving the applicable entitlement. MESH may also make reasonable modifications required for compatibility, safety, intellectual-property, legal, or platform reasons.

NO RANDOMIZED PAID ITEMS AT PRESENT

MESH does not currently offer paid randomized Digital Item mechanics. If MESH introduces randomized paid items in the future, additional disclosures, rules, or odds information may apply.

10. PHILANTHROPY EXPERIENCES

MESH may facilitate philanthropy-related experiences in which a sponsor agrees to make a charitable donation connected to a MESH league, challenge, community, or season outcome. Unless expressly stated otherwise, the charitable contribution is made by the sponsor directly to a legitimate charitable organization or through the organization’s valid donation channel; MESH does not award the charitable funds to the winning user or squad as personal property.

MESH may facilitate communication between the sponsor and an eligible winning squad or community so that the group can identify a qualifying charitable organization or provide a legitimate donation link. A philanthropy-related outcome is not a cash prize to participating users, and participating users have no right to withdraw, redirect for personal use, or personally receive charitable funds.
